label: Dreame X40 Ultra robot vacuum and mop
description: Dreame X40 Ultra is a 12000 Pa robot vacuum and mop with an extending side brush, a self-cleaning mop dock and multi-floor LiDAR maps managed from the Dreamehome app. Its only network interface is 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (no 5 GHz support, no Ethernet port and no PoE), so it is a pure wireless client on the IoT SSID.
